name: mutation-session
body: A session-scoped process that owns one worktree DB for the duration of an update session (`apg session start` … `apg session end`). It is ephemeral, not a daemon: it lives only for the session, holds the DB as single writer, applies mutation attempts in order, and applies each mutation's exact projection delta synchronously through the write-through projection (no deferred or batched flush); it also serves reads routed to it (read-through) so external readers see applied mutations. It is reachable only through a Unix socket under `apg/.trans/`. Its guarantee is ownership of the whole durable write — the node-file read-modify-write, the per-mutation commit, and the projection record, as well as the DB as single writer — so no other writer can race it, not merely no other DB opener.
